name: EZIO8T
description: An I/O module in the EZIOxx line.

verification.note: The EZIOxx Advanced Details cover the whole EZIOxx line, from inputs-only to outputs-only models, and warn that a model may not support every command.

notes: No document gives a model number; the profile is named for the product.
Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008) records that the EZIO8T moved to 0x07/0x02 in November 2006; the EZIOxx Advanced Details give 0x07/0x02 for EZIO as a whole.
No document found gives its inputs, outputs or ratings.
sources: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008)
